title: 2017 HMMT November Guts Problem 35

solutions.text:
Answer: 1015080877
This is the same problem as in OEIS A153588. It is helpful to see (or guess) that neither the numerator or the denominator of the final resistance exceed the \((n+1)\)-th Fibonacci number, which in this case is \(F_{25}=75025\), using concepts on the line of continued fractions. So \(75025^{2} \approx 5.6 \times 10^{9}\) is an upper bound for the total number, which is already close to the final answer. Multiplying by some constant factor to remove non-reduced fractions (such as \(\frac{3}{4}\) to deal with parity) will improve this result.
